_comment: Which vitals come from the monitor vs. are measured by hand (SPEC §6, §14). Monitor fields are never typed by students.

alarmLimits._comment: Monitor alarms when a value is outside [low, high] (null = no limit). Instructor to confirm (SPEC §14).

monitorLeads._comment: Which monitor parts a connection gives. Interventions/orders connect via the catalog flag monitorConnects; 'Connect to monitor' connects all.
